arguments.message: The date of your next invoice is shown in Settings → Billing → Plan under the heading “Next invoice”. That date stays the same each month (for example, a billing date of the 31st will bill on the last day of a shorter month). Because the card charge happens on that date, it’s enough to replace your card a day or two beforehand to make sure the new card is used for the upcoming invoice.
